item.title: Masked men demand cash in village pub robbery
item.description: Detectives investigating a break-in at a village pub have appealed for anyone with additional information to come forward. Police were called at 3.12am on Friday 19 December after four masked men entered the Old Reindeer, in Main Street, Edingley, and demanded money. item.title: Fire crews attended campervan blaze on the A1 in Nottinghamshire
item.description: Crews from Tuxford fire station attended the blaze on the A1. A spokesperson for Tuxford Fire Station said: ‘We have had a steady stream of incidents over the last weeks including RTCs and AFAs. ‘This afternoon, Saturday 20 December – we found ourselves on the A1 dealing with a campervan fire.’
